spec.goal: Make `npm test` succeed on Node 20 in both packages by unquoting the `--test` glob in the root and toy/ package.json test scripts, and add one new guard test under substrate/test/ that fails if (a) the support floor in engines.node and the node-version pinned in .github/workflows/ci.yml ever disagree, or (b) either package.json test script re-quotes its glob. The resolution is fixed by the work item and is not open for redesign: unquote the globs, keep engines.node at ">=20", keep ci.yml's node-version at 20, do not touch ci.yml. Measured in this container on Node v22.22.2 before any change: `node --test substrate/test/*.test.js` (unquoted) passes with 132 tests — the work item's "114 passing" figure is stale, since substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js has been added since it was written, so the implementer records the count actually observed rather than 114; `NODE_ENV=test node --test test/*.test.js` in toy/ passes with 60 tests; the quoted form also passes on Node 22, which is exactly why the defect was invisible; and `node --test substrate/test/` fails with `Error: Cannot find module '/home/user/company-graph/substrate/test'` / `code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND'`, so a bare directory argument is NOT an acceptable substitute. The glob must stay `*.test.js`, not `*.js`: substrate/test/ contains non-test helper modules (helpers.js, fixloop-helpers.js, t2-doc-paths.js, extract-fixloop.js) that must not be executed as tests.

acceptance.given: the repository root package.json, whose "test" script is currently `node --test "substrate/test/*.test.js"`
acceptance.when: the file is read after the change
acceptance.then: the "test" script is exactly `node --test substrate/test/*.test.js` — the same command with the double quotes around the glob removed, the glob still ending in `*.test.js`, no directory-only argument, no added flags, no wrapper script, and every other field of package.json (name, version, private, description, type, engines, bin, the other scripts, dependencies) byte-identical to before

acceptance.given: toy/package.json, whose "test" script is currently `NODE_ENV=test node --test "test/*.test.js"`
acceptance.when: the file is read after the change
acceptance.then: the "test" script is exactly `NODE_ENV=test node --test test/*.test.js` — quotes removed, the `NODE_ENV=test` prefix preserved, the glob still ending in `*.test.js`, and every other field of toy/package.json byte-identical to before

acceptance.when: `git diff --name-only` is inspected after the change
acceptance.then: the changed paths are exactly package.json, toy/package.json and the one new guard test file under substrate/test/ — .github/workflows/ci.yml is byte-identical to before, package.json still declares engines.node ">=20", ci.yml still pins node-version: 20, and no file under substrate/ other than the new test, and no file under toy/src/, is modified

acceptance.given: a new test file under substrate/test/ whose name ends in .test.js (so the repaired glob collects it), reading .github/workflows/ci.yml as plain text and package.json as JSON, with no YAML parser and no new dependency
acceptance.when: the suite runs against the fixed tree
acceptance.then: it passes an assertion that the numeric major version parsed out of package.json's engines.node range (">=20" → 20) equals the numeric node-version pinned in the actions/setup-node `with:` block of ci.yml, matched by regex over the workflow text in the style of the existing substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js

acceptance.given: the same new guard test file
acceptance.when: the suite runs against the fixed tree
acceptance.then: it passes an assertion that neither package.json's nor toy/package.json's "test" script wraps its `--test` glob argument in quote characters (" or '), and that each script still passes a glob ending in `*.test.js` rather than a bare directory

acceptance.given: that a guard which has never failed proves nothing, and that the guard must be demonstrated against the pre-fix state without re-introducing the defect
acceptance.when: the new guard test file is run
acceptance.then: both guard checks are implemented as pure functions of supplied content (a workflow-text string and a package-script string) rather than reading the real files inline, and the same file additionally asserts negative cases — the quote check rejects the literal pre-fix scripts `node --test "substrate/test/*.test.js"` and `NODE_ENV=test node --test "test/*.test.js"`, and the floor check rejects a synthetic workflow text pinning node-version to a value other than the engines.node floor — so the failing-against-pre-fix-state evidence is executed by the suite itself rather than only asserted in prose

acceptance.given: the fixed tree on the container's Node (v22.22.2), with the scripts now in the form Node 20 also accepts
acceptance.when: `npm test` is run at the repository root and `npm test` is run in toy/
acceptance.then: both exit 0, the root suite reports the full set of substrate tests passing (132 at spec time, plus the tests added by AC-4/AC-5/AC-6; the count must not be lower than the pre-change count) with 0 failures, the toy suite reports 60 passing with 0 failures, and neither run loads substrate/test/helpers.js, substrate/test/fixloop-helpers.js, substrate/test/t2-doc-paths.js, substrate/test/extract-fixloop.js or toy/test/helpers.js as a test file

acceptance.given: the existing substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js, in particular its AC-4 test asserting node-version 20 against engines.node ">=20"
acceptance.when: the suite runs after the change
acceptance.then: that file is unmodified and every one of its tests still passes — the new guard is additive and does not amend, weaken, or duplicate-and-replace AC-4 of spec-wi-c4-ci

acceptance.given: the dependency surface of both packages
acceptance.when: the dependency blocks of package.json and toy/package.json and any lockfiles are inspected after the change
acceptance.then: no dependency is added, removed, or upgraded in either package — in particular no YAML parser — and the new guard test imports only node: builtins plus, at most, existing helper modules already present in substrate/test/

out_of_scope: Changing engines.node in either package.json (it stays ">=20"), or adding an engines block to toy/package.json.
Editing .github/workflows/ci.yml in any way, including changing node-version away from 20, adding a version matrix, or adding/removing steps.
Amending, weakening, or relocating AC-4 of spec-wi-c4-ci, or editing any assertion in substrate/test/ci-workflow.test.js.
Modifying any existing test file under substrate/test/ or toy/test/, including the shared helper modules (helpers.js, fixloop-helpers.js, t2-doc-paths.js, extract-fixloop.js, toy/test/helpers.js).
Modifying any source under substrate/ (validator.js, artifacts.js, gates.js, ledger.js, deploy.js, lib/) or under toy/src/ (app.js, server.js).
Adding, removing, or upgrading any dependency in either package, explicitly including a YAML parser — the workflow is asserted on as text.

Replacing the glob with a bare directory argument (`node --test substrate/test/`, which throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND), widening it to `*.js`, changing --test-reporter or --experimental-test-* flags, or introducing a cross-platform wrapper script or third-party test runner.
Fixing, re-running, or otherwise acting on GitHub Actions run 34667094594 or PR #8 — CI going green is the observed consequence of the tree change, not a deliverable of the implementer.
Any change to the substrate artifact store, gate queue, ledger, contracts.schema.json, or the workflows and agent definitions under .claude/.
Adding Windows/cmd.exe compatibility for the unquoted glob, or any change driven by shells other than the POSIX shell npm uses on the CI runner and in this container.
risk_reasons: Additive and reversible: removes quotes from shell strings in package.json scripts and adds one test file; both easily undone
No external consumers: client is self (venture 0); no external APIs or contracts to break
No infrastructure/data/auth changes: script definitions are not app config or dependencies; CI workflow excluded from scope; no data model changes
Scope-limited to two package.json files and one new test file; major systems (workflows, agents, substrate, source code) out-of-scope
Functionally equivalent on Node 20: unquoted glob already verified to pass; no behavior change, only shell syntax normalization
Safety-improving: new guard test ensures Node version floor and CI pinning stay aligned, preventing regressions

tasks.description: Unquote the --test glob in package.json and toy/package.json test scripts, and add a new guard test that verifies the node support floor in engines.node matches the node-version in ci.yml, and that both test scripts use unquoted globs ending in *.test.js
